(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    mushroom08 sausage08 plantain08 nugget08 parsnip08 carrot08 celery08 peas08 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
  )

  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (cut ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))))

    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut mushroom08)) (at start (marinator_free)))

              (at start (not (marinator_free)))
              (at end (marinated mushroom08))
              (at end (stackable mushroom08))
              (at end (marinator_free))))

              (at end (grill_free))))

              (at end (fried plantain08))

              (at end (fryer_free))))

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    tofu08 potato08 zucchini08 carrot08 celery08 peas08 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    (done_grill_tofu08)
    (done_mash_potato08)
    (done_boil_peas08)
    (lag_ready_stack_tofu08)
    (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash)
    (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil)
  )

  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at end (cut ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (cut ?i)))
      (at start (not (marinator_free)))
      (at end (marinated ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (marinator_free))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (boiler_free)))
      (at end (boiled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (boiler_free))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at end (mashed ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
      (at end (done_mash_potato08))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action fry_zucchini08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut zucchini08)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (cut zucchini08)))
      (at start (not (fryer_free)))
      (at end (fried zucchini08))
      (at end (stackable zucchini08))
      (at end (fryer_free))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action grill_tofu08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated tofu08)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (marinated tofu08)))
      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at end (grilled tofu08))
      (at end (stackable tofu08))
      (at end (grill_free))
      (at end (done_grill_tofu08))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action mash_potato08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled potato08)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (boiled potato08)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at end (mashed potato08))
      (at end (stackable potato08))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
      (at end (done_mash_potato08))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action boil_peas08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw peas08)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw peas08)))
      (at start (not (boiler_free)))
      (at end (boiled peas08))
      (at end (stackable peas08))
      (at end (boiler_free))
      (at end (done_boil_peas08))
    )
  )

  ;; Stack actions in the required order (each stack action is a separate durative-action)
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_tofu08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable tofu08)) (at start (grilled tofu08)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_tofu08)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable tofu08))) (at end (stacked tofu08)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_carrot08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable carrot08)) (at start (cut carrot08)) (at start (stacked tofu08)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable carrot08))) (at end (stacked carrot08)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_celery08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable celery08)) (at start (cut celery08)) (at start (stacked carrot08)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable celery08))) (at end (stacked celery08)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked celery08)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top)))
  )

  ;; Wait helper actions for temporal lags
  (:durative-action wait_grill_tofu08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (done_grill_tofu08)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_tofu08)))
  )

  (:durative-action wait_mash_potato08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (done_mash_potato08)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash)))
  )

  (:durative-action wait_boil_peas08
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (done_boil_peas08)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil)))
  )
)

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    salmon18 turnip18 okra18 tomato18 pepper18 broth18 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    ;; completion and lag predicates for temporal constraints
    (done_grill_salmon18)
    (lag_ready_stack_salmon18)
    (done_mash_turnip18)
    (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash)
    (done_boil_broth18)
    (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil)
  )

  ;; generic cut action: raw -> cut, uses cutting board
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free))) (at end (cut ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (cutting_board_free)))
  )

  ;; generic boil action: raw -> boiled, uses boiler
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (boiler_free))) (at end (boiled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (boiler_free)))
  )

  ;; generic marinate: cut -> marinated, uses marinator
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut ?i))) (at start (not (marinator_free))) (at end (marinated ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (marinator_free)))
  )

  ;; generic fry is specialized for okra (must be cut first) -> create item-specific fry_okra18
  (:durative-action fry_okra18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut okra18)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut okra18))) (at start (not (fryer_free))) (at end (fried okra18)) (at end (stackable okra18)) (at end (fryer_free)))
  )

  ;; generic mash is specialized for turnip to allow completion predicate -> boiled -> mashed
  (:durative-action mash_turnip18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled turnip18)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (boiled turnip18))) (at start (not (cutting_board_free))) (at end (mashed turnip18)) (at end (stackable turnip18)) (at end (cutting_board_free)) (at end (done_mash_turnip18)))
  )

  ;; grill specialized for salmon: requires marinated salmon18 -> grilled
  (:durative-action grill_salmon18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated salmon18)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (marinated salmon18))) (at start (not (grill_free))) (at end (grilled salmon18)) (at end (stackable salmon18)) (at end (grill_free)) (at end (done_grill_salmon18)))
  )

  ;; boil specialized for broth to allow completion predicate
  (:durative-action boil_broth18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw broth18)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw broth18))) (at start (not (boiler_free))) (at end (boiled broth18)) (at end (stackable broth18)) (at end (boiler_free)) (at end (done_boil_broth18)))
  )

  ;; generic marinate_salmon could be done via generic marinate, but we keep generic marinate; no separate action needed

  ;; stack actions in required order: bun_bot -> salmon18 -> tomato18 -> pepper18 -> bun_top
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_salmon18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable salmon18)) (at start (grilled salmon18)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_salmon18)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable salmon18))) (at end (stacked salmon18)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_tomato18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable tomato18)) (at start (cut tomato18)) (at start (stacked salmon18)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable tomato18))) (at end (stacked tomato18)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_pepper18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable pepper18)) (at start (cut pepper18)) (at start (stacked tomato18)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable pepper18))) (at end (stacked pepper18)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked pepper18)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top)))
  )

  ;; waits to enforce temporal lags
  (:durative-action wait_grill_salmon18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 5)
    :condition (and (at start (done_grill_salmon18)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_salmon18)))
  )

  (:durative-action wait_mash_turnip18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (done_mash_turnip18)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash)))
  )

  (:durative-action wait_boil_broth18
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (done_boil_broth18)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil)))
  )
)

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item robot)
  (:constants
    patty05 steak05 fish05 potato05 yam05 lettuce05 cucumber05 stock05 bun_bot bun_top - item
    robot1 robot2 - robot
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    (robot_free ?r - robot)
  )

  ;; Generic grill for items grillable from raw
  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (grilled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (grill_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Grill steak05 requires marinated input -> create item-specific grounded action
  (:durative-action grill_steak05
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated steak05)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (marinated steak05)))
      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (grilled steak05))
      (at end (stackable steak05))
      (at end (grill_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (cut ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Fry generic for items fryable from raw
  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (fryer_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (fried ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (fryer_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Fry potato05 requires it to be cut first -> item-specific action
  (:durative-action fry_potato05
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut potato05)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (cut potato05)))
      (at start (not (fryer_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (fried potato05))
      (at end (stackable potato05))
      (at end (fryer_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (boiler_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (boiled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (boiler_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Marinate requires cut -> item-specific marinate for steak05
  (:durative-action marinate_steak05
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut steak05)) (at start (marinator_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (cut steak05)))
      (at start (not (marinator_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (marinated steak05))
      (at end (stackable steak05))
      (at end (marinator_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Mash yam05 requires boiled input
  (:durative-action mash_yam05
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled yam05)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (boiled yam05)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (mashed yam05))
      (at end (stackable yam05))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Stack actions in order (one per item). Robot parameterized.
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot)) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (robot_free ?r)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_patty05
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable patty05)) (at start (grilled patty05)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable patty05))) (at end (stacked patty05)) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (robot_free ?r)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_lettuce05
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable lettuce05)) (at start (cut lettuce05)) (at start (stacked patty05)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable lettuce05))) (at end (stacked lettuce05)) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (robot_free ?r)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_steak05
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable steak05)) (at start (grilled steak05)) (at start (stacked lettuce05)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable steak05))) (at end (stacked steak05)) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (robot_free ?r)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_cucumber05
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable cucumber05)) (at start (cut cucumber05)) (at start (stacked steak05)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable cucumber05))) (at end (stacked cucumber05)) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (robot_free ?r)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters (?r - robot)

    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top)) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (robot_free ?r)))

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item robot)
  (:constants
    chicken15 tempeh15 shrimp15 okra15 cassava15 pickle15 radish15 beans15 bun_bot bun_top - item
    robot1 robot2 - robot
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free1)
    (grill_free2)
    (grill_free3)
    (cutting_board_free1)
    (cutting_board_free2)
    (cutting_board_free3)
    (fryer_free1)
    (fryer_free2)
    (boiler_free1)
    (boiler_free2)
    (marinator_free1)
    (marinator_free2)
    (robot_free ?r - robot)
  )

  ;; Generic grill for items that can be grilled from raw
  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free1)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (raw ?i)))
             (at start (not (grill_free1)))
             (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
             (at end (grilled ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (grill_free1))
             (at end (robot_free ?r)) ))

  ;; Item-specific grill for tempeh15 which requires marinated input
  (:durative-action grill_tempeh15
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated tempeh15)) (at start (grill_free2)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (marinated tempeh15)))
             (at start (not (grill_free2)))
             (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
             (at end (grilled tempeh15))
             (at end (stackable tempeh15))
             (at end (grill_free2))
             (at end (robot_free ?r)) ))

  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free1)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (raw ?i)))
             (at start (not (cutting_board_free1)))
             (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
             (at end (cut ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (cutting_board_free1))
             (at end (robot_free ?r)) ))

  ;; marinate requires cut -> marinated
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free1)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (cut ?i)))
             (at start (not (marinator_free1)))
             (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
             (at end (marinated ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (marinator_free1))
             (at end (robot_free ?r)) ))

  ;; generic fry from raw
  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (fryer_free1)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (raw ?i)))
             (at start (not (fryer_free1)))
             (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
             (at end (fried ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (fryer_free1))
             (at end (robot_free ?r)) ))

  ;; item-specific fry for okra15 which requires cut input
  (:durative-action fry_okra15
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut okra15)) (at start (fryer_free2)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (cut okra15)))
             (at start (not (fryer_free2)))
             (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
             (at end (fried okra15))
             (at end (stackable okra15))
             (at end (fryer_free2))
             (at end (robot_free ?r)) ))

  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free1)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (raw ?i)))
             (at start (not (boiler_free1)))
             (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
             (at end (boiled ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (boiler_free1))
             (at end (robot_free ?r)) ))

  ;; mash requires boiled -> mashed, uses cutting board
  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free2)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
             (at start (not (cutting_board_free2)))
             (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
             (at end (mashed ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (cutting_board_free2))
             (at end (robot_free ?r)) ))

  ;; Stacking actions for final assembly order. Each requires item-specific processed state when applicable.
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked bun_bot)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  (:durative-action stack_chicken15
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable chicken15)) (at start (grilled chicken15)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable chicken15))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked chicken15)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  (:durative-action stack_pickle15
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable pickle15)) (at start (cut pickle15)) (at start (stacked chicken15)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable pickle15))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked pickle15)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  (:durative-action stack_tempeh15
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable tempeh15)) (at start (grilled tempeh15)) (at start (stacked pickle15)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable tempeh15))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked tempeh15)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  (:durative-action stack_radish15
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable radish15)) (at start (cut radish15)) (at start (stacked tempeh15)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable radish15))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked radish15)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked radish15)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked bun_top)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))

## Available Actions
- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item. NOTE: some items must be marinated before they can be grilled (see ingredients).
- **cut** `<item>`  —  Chop a raw item on the cutting board. Takes 3 seconds. Produces a cut item.
- **fry** `<item>`  —  Fry an item in a fryer. Takes 8 seconds. Produces a fried item. NOTE: some items must be cut before they can be fried (see ingredients).
- **boil** `<item>`  —  Boil an item. Takes 12 seconds. Produces a boiled item.
- **marinate** `<item>`  —  Marinate a cut item. Takes 6 seconds. Produces a marinated item. The item must be cut first.
- **mash** `<item>`  —  Mash a boiled item on the cutting board. Takes 4 seconds. Produces a mashed item. The item must be boiled first.
- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

- **grill**: capacity 3 (at most 3 grill actions running at once)
- **cutting board**: capacity 4 (at most 4 cut/mash actions running at once)
- **fryer**: capacity 3 (at most 3 fry actions running at once)
- **boiler**: capacity 3 (at most 3 boil actions running at once)
- **marinator**: capacity 3 (at most 3 marinate actions running at once)

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    feast_plate patty13 salmon13 chicken13 tofu13 fish13 falafel13 potato13 onion13 yam13 turnip13 stock13 beans13 lettuce13 tomato13 cucumber13 carrot13 - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
  )

  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (raw ?i)))
             (at start (not (grill_free)))
             (at end (grilled ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (grill_free))))

  (:durative-action grill_chicken13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated chicken13)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (marinated chicken13)))
             (at start (not (grill_free)))
             (at end (grilled chicken13))
             (at end (stackable chicken13))
             (at end (grill_free))))

  (:durative-action grill_tofu13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated tofu13)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (marinated tofu13)))
             (at start (not (grill_free)))
             (at end (grilled tofu13))
             (at end (stackable tofu13))
             (at end (grill_free))))

  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (raw ?i)))
             (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
             (at end (cut ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (cutting_board_free))))

  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (raw ?i)))
             (at start (not (fryer_free)))
             (at end (fried ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (fryer_free))))

  (:durative-action fry_potato13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut potato13)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (cut potato13)))
             (at start (not (fryer_free)))
             (at end (fried potato13))
             (at end (stackable potato13))
             (at end (fryer_free))))

  (:durative-action fry_onion13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut onion13)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (cut onion13)))
             (at start (not (fryer_free)))
             (at end (fried onion13))
             (at end (stackable onion13))
             (at end (fryer_free))))

  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (raw ?i)))
             (at start (not (boiler_free)))
             (at end (boiled ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (boiler_free))))

  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (cut ?i)))
             (at start (not (marinator_free)))
             (at end (marinated ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (marinator_free))))

  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
             (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
             (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
             (at end (mashed ?i))
             (at end (stackable ?i))
             (at end (cutting_board_free))))

  (:durative-action stack_feast_plate
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable feast_plate)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable feast_plate))) (at end (stacked feast_plate))))
)

  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    feast_plate patty15 salmon15 chicken15 tofu15 fish15 falafel15 potato15 onion15 yam15 turnip15 stock15 beans15 lettuce15 tomato15 cucumber15 carrot15 - item

  (:durative-action fry_potato15
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut potato15)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (cut potato15))) (at start (not (fryer_free))) (at end (fried potato15)) (at end (stackable potato15)) (at end (fryer_free))))
